title: ChecklistLeo (TSV)
description: Upload format: TSV file in the Bizchat Converged (CWC) format used by SEVAL's ChecklistLeo metric. The JSON Schema below describes the in-memory shape after CsvValidator converts each TSV row into a JSON object (the full file becomes a JSON array) ΓÇö it is NOT the upload format. Each row has two columns: 'query' (a JSON-encoded array of conversation turns) and 'metadata' (a JSON object carrying at least `segment`). Checks may be attached inline on a turn (`checks` / `checklistleo`) or at the metadata level (`checklistleo`), and cascade down per ChecklistLeo's configuration model.

query.description: JSON array of conversation turns (parsed from JSON in the 'query'/'conversation' TSV column). Supports single-turn and multi-turn conversations.

metadata.description: JSON object (parsed from JSON in the 'metadata' TSV column). Must carry a `segment`; may carry a `checklistleo` cascading config that applies to all turns.

checks.description: Inline checks evaluated against the response to this turn. Each entry is a short-form string or a long-form check object.

segment.description: Segment classification used to group conversations.

checklistleoConfig.description: ChecklistLeo cascading configuration object. Holds a `checks` array plus any check properties that cascade down to the checks defined inside it.

prompt_template.description: Jinja2 prompt template override applied to natural-language checks at this level.

custom_prompt_template.description: Fully custom Jinja2 prompt template (used with natural_check_type = 'custom').

base_configuration.description: Base configuration reference, e.g. 'config:ruleleo' to enable RuleLeo-compatible mode.

check.description: A ChecklistLeo check. Short-form is a string (optionally prefixed with 'jmespath:' or 'pythonic:'); long-form is an object with a `check` plus properties.
The check body: natural-language statement, JMESPath expression, or Pythonic function reference.

type.description: Check type. Defaults to 'natural' when omitted. A prefix in the check string ('jmespath:'/'pythonic:') takes precedence.

args.description: Arguments for pythonic checks (ignored for other types). Values must be Python primitive literals.

custom_prompt_template.description: Fully custom Jinja2 prompt template (used with natural_check_type = 'custom').

additionalFields.description: Response fields (from the SydneyResponse object) to include in a natural-language check's prompt. Either an array of field names or an object mapping field name to a human-readable label.

importance.description: Weight/priority of the check when aggregating scores. Default 10. For LMChecklist compatibility use 10 (critical), 9 (expected), or 8 (aspirational).

owners.description: Set of owners (team or person) responsible for the check. Merged across cascading levels.

previousTurns.description: Number of previous turns to include as context. 0 (default) = current turn only; a positive integer = up to that many prior turns; '*' = all previous turns.

selector.description: Selects which turns a check applies to. A turn selector ('turns') or a query-regex selector ('query-regex').

turns.description: Turn index selector (0-indexed, Python slice semantics). Examples: '*', '0', '-1', '0:2', '-2:-1'.

query-regex.description: Python regular expression matched (re.search) against the turn's query text.
